config.description: An evaluation metric the paper reports results on. canonical is factual_accuracy for accuracy of the answers (accuracy, exact match, factual accuracy), hallucination_rate for the rate of hallucinated or unsupported answers, other for anything else (latency, BLEU, fluency).

name.description: the metric's name as the paper gives it

chain-of-thought: model prompted to reason step by step
fine-tuned: generator adapted to the domain by further training
no-retrieval: model that answers from its own parameters
language model used on its own
plain generator with no lookup step
query-rewriting: variant that reformulates the question before the search
rag: model that consults the document index before answering
variant that reads retrieved evidence first
configuration that looks up supporting documents
rag-no-rerank: retrieval variant that skips the reranker
rag-random: variant fed with randomly drawn passages
self-consistency: model that samples several answers and votes
